description: Source code for the SQLStore implementation in the focalboard server, managing database interactions including connection, migration, and version checks.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Represents a SQL database store with methods for database operations and configuration.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SQLStore with provided parameters, initializes database connection, and performs migrations.

methods.name: IsMariaDB
methods.description: Checks if the connected database is MariaDB.

methods.name: computeBinaryParam
methods.description: Determines if the Postgres data source uses binary_parameters.

methods.name: getQueryBuilder
methods.description: Returns a SQL query builder configured for the database type.

methods.name: escapeField
methods.description: Escapes a field name according to the database type.

methods.name: concatenationSelector
methods.description: Returns a SQL expression for concatenating fields with a delimiter.

methods.name: elementInColumn
methods.description: Returns a SQL expression to check if an element exists in a column.

methods.name: searchUserChannels
methods.description: Searches user channels (not supported in standalone mode).

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves a channel (not supported in standalone mode).
